publication_override.scope: installation and use on the owner's own Windows computer

not_validated: No person has installed or used 2.0.0 on a real Windows PC; only the GitHub windows-latest runner installed it silently, ran --smoke and the start-up probe, and uninstalled it.
Liquid glass, Mica, the cursor lens, the new shadow and the keyboard focus ring were seen only in host renders and tests, not on a real Windows GPU; frame rate on 120/144 Hz screens was not measured.
The ketmix-pc-v1 models on a real graphics card (DirectML/GPU path) and the desktop-versus-laptop detection were not tried on real hardware.
WASAPI exclusive mode and true gapless were not heard on a real audio device.
The Discord IPC pipe, DPAPI-protected tokens, relaunch into another local profile and click-through floating lyrics were not tried on Windows.
Last.fm sign-in through Supabase was not completed with a real user; the key pair was checked with Last.fm directly.
Live sync, device move and rooms between a real phone and Windows were not tried.
Upgrading a real 1.2.0 installation to 2.0.0 was not tried.
The MSI is not code-signed; Windows SmartScreen will warn about an unknown publisher.
known_limitations: No light/dark/system theme choice on Windows: the window follows Windows.
The phone is only reachable for phone control while its app is open or playing.

features_2_0.account: Connections page (Discord, Last.fm, ListenBrainz), Discord presence, offline-queued scrobbling, live sync with the phone, connected devices, QR/code sign-in, several local profiles, Mes données (export, delete, list of what leaves the PC), no telemetry
features_2_0.together: listening rooms shared with phones, profiles with visibility per module, optional friends activity, smart share links opening the app
features_2_0.sources_playback: manifest.json sources with test, order and account sync, catalogue, smart cache, optional exclusive mode and true gapless
features_2_0.lyrics_library: AI word sync on desktop PCs (ketvoice-align-v1), multi-source lyrics ranking, translation and romanisation, floating lyrics, outside playlist import with report and follow, drop anywhere, watched folders
